title: Ma Gomba Has Mushrooms

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: If you're here to buy, I'm here to sell... perhaps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're here to buy, I'm here to sell... perhaps.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: It depends if I decide you're worth my time. Appearances can be so deceiving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It depends if I decide you're worth my time. Appearances can be so deceiving.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: The spores of success. I can help you grow from the dirt into the clouds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The spores of success. I can help you grow from the dirt into the clouds.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: You obviously haven't heard of me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You obviously haven't heard of me.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: How toxic. I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How toxic. I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I sell the finest funghi in Nivalis. I have customers in the Spire, the resorts... CEOs have been known to woo me for months just to get a taste.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: They are. Enoki, shiitake, morel, bioluminescent, mind-expanding... People can't get enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They are. Enoki, shiitake, morel, bioluminescent, mind-expanding... People can't get enough.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: In you I see potential. But if you want to bloom, you must consume.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In you I see potential. But if you want to bloom, you must consume.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: It pains me to see such stunted ambition. Well, if you change your mind...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It pains me to see such stunted ambition. Well, if you change your mind...

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Meaning I must decide if you are a worthy host for my products before I sell. Come see me again and I'll have a little task for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meaning I must decide if you are a worthy host for my products before I sell. Come see me again and I'll have a little task for you.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: You'll see. Trust is the fertilizer of every good business partnership.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll see. Trust is the fertilizer of every good business partnership.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Perhaps not. Though in you, I see potential. But as the old saying goes, if you want to bloom, you must consume.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps not. Though in you, I see potential. But as the old saying goes, if you want to bloom, you must consume.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: A noble art with great rewards. You will need a special mushroom module for your greenhouse, of course. And the correct conditions. High humidity, low light... and spores to get started. You won't find better than what I sell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A noble art with great rewards. You will need a special mushroom module for your greenhouse, of course. And the correct conditions. High humidity, low light... and spores to get started. You won't find better than what I sell.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Oh, there are module vendors all over the LUZ. No harm in starting cheap with a C Grade model. Fungi can be forgiving, even to beginners.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, there are module vendors all over the LUZ. No harm in starting cheap with a C Grade model. Fungi can be forgiving, even to beginners.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Perhaps"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Perhaps"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sell what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sell what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So can manners. What are you selling?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So can manners. What are you selling?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So can manners. What are you selling?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So can manners. What are you selling?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm quite happy in the dirt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm quite happy in the dirt.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm quite happy in the dirt.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm quite happy in the dirt.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Obviously.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And I'm happy keeping it that way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I'm happy keeping it that way.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And I'm happy keeping it that way.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And I'm happy keeping it that way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't know people were so into mushrooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't know people were so into mushrooms.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't know people were so into mushrooms.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't know people were so into mushrooms.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think anyone would mistake me for a CEO.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think anyone would mistake me for a CEO.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think anyone would mistake me for a CEO.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think anyone would mistake me for a CEO.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if I wanted to buy some...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if I wanted to buy some...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if I wanted to buy some...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if I wanted to buy some...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meaning what exactly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meaning what exactly?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not interested.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of task?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of task?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can you tell me about growing mushrooms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can you tell me about growing mushrooms?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can you tell me about growing mushrooms?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can you tell me about growing mushrooms?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I look forward to it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I look forward to it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I buy a module?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I buy a module?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where can I buy a module?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where can I buy a module?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep that in mind.
